content.short: Ripio delivers secure, certified infrastructure enabling institutions to integrate scalable crypto solutions.
content.description: Ripio delivers Crypto-as-a-Service via a straightforward API integration, letting banks and fintechs add crypto offerings for their customers. The platform supports buy, hold, and sell operations, includes a white-label widget for branding, and provides fiat-to-crypto ramps tailored to Latin America. It is currently available in Argentina, Brazil, and Mexico, with plans to expand to additional countries soon.
content.meta: Ripio enables Crypto-as-a-Service via a simple API for banks and fintechs to offer crypto. Discover Ripio and other Web3 Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
